headline: Four steps from where you are to where you want to be.
subheading: No long retainers before we've even started. No jargon. Just a clear process that moves at your pace and keeps you in control.

steps.title: Free strategy call
steps.description: We talk about your business, your goals, and your challenges. This is a genuine conversation, not a discovery call designed to end in a sales pitch. If we're a good fit, great. If not, I'll point you in the right direction.

steps.title: Discovery & research
steps.description: I dig into your market, your competitors, and your customers. I ask questions, look at data, and spend time understanding your business properly. This is where the real insight comes from, and it's what makes everything else work.

steps.title: Strategy delivery
steps.description: You get a clear, actionable strategy: not a 50-page document you'll never read, but a focused plan you can actually use. We walk through it together so there are no unanswered questions.

steps.title: Support & iteration
steps.description: I don't disappear after delivery. We check in, review what's working, and adjust as needed. Whether you want ongoing support or just a hand getting started, I'm here.

cta.headline: Ready to get started?
cta.subheading: Step one is always free. Book a call and let's see where it goes.
